data.exact_reserve_text: The gross claims development table shows a decrease in the ultimate estimate for the 2014 underwriting year from GBP 125,747k to GBP 101,239k, a release of GBP 24,508k. For the 2015 underwriting year, the ultimate estimate decreased from GBP 42,790k to GBP 41,766k, a release of GBP 1,024k. The total gross prior year development for underwriting years 2015 and prior is a release of GBP 25,532k.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 25.532 million, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2014 and 2015 underwriting years as evidenced by the claims development triangle. The 2014 underwriting year saw a release of GBP 24.508 million, while the 2015 underwriting year contributed a release of GBP 1.024 million.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross premium mix by line of business is not provided in the segmental analysis notes. The claims development triangle is used for prior year development, excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2016). The percentage for prior_year_development_pct is calculated based on the opening gross claims outstanding for 2016 (GBP 110.778m).
